description:
Spec-only ball. Pin the remaining tool-contract gaps in ARCH §3.3 / §3.2 now that the v0.3 layout is settled (abfe713). Some decisions a previous attempt pinned are preserved; some must be retargeted against the new layout; one framing question is still open.

=== Context ===

A previous attempt (claim dropped 2026-04-24, agent died mid-task) produced a substantive uncommitted docs/ARCHITECTURE.md draft saved at ~/tmp/bl-e2fb-salvage-2026-04-24.patch. Mine it for the decisions below — do NOT mechanically apply: it assumed the pre-abfe713 layout (exchanges/<id>/steps/…, agents.yaml, template/.agent/), which no longer exists.

=== Decisions to preserve from the salvage draft ===

- CLI surface: in-process tools are 'lernie tool <name>' subcommands; external tools are 'lernie-tool-<name>' on PATH (mirrors §4.4 providers).
- Stdio contract:
  - stdin = the tool_use.input JSON object verbatim; the tool owns its own validation.
  - stdout = raw bytes, wrapped as tool_result.content; no harness-side JSON envelope.
  - stderr = captured unconditionally; concatenated into tool_result.content on non-zero exit.
  - exit code: 0 → is_error=false; non-zero → is_error=true. Signal-caused termination other than the harness's own SIGTERM = harness-level fault per §2.10.
  - SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after 5s (mirrors §4.4).
- One commit per tool call on the emitting branch, not batched (batching would force a dirty worktree between siblings).
- Per-call files: input.json (the tool_use block) and output.json (stdout bytes, stderr on non-zero, exit_code, started_at, ended_at). Temp-path + atomic rename.
- v0.3 does NOT implement oversized-output auto-dispatch; deferred to v0.4+ explicitly in §11.

=== Retarget against abfe713 ===

- Per-tool-call dir is steps/<conv-id>/<NNN>/tools/<tool-id>/, NOT exchanges/<id>/steps/<NNN>/tool_calls/<tool-id>/. The exchanges/ root is gone; the tool_calls/ name is replaced by tools/.
- Tools-list source is the per-repo providers.yaml roles: section (per bl-7c23 scope item #3/#4), NOT agents.yaml. agents.yaml is retired entirely.
- Skill on-disk: <harness-root>/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, loaded into <worktree>/skills/<name>/ at branch creation (bl-7c23 item #11). NOT template/.agent/system/tools/<name>/.
- Tool schema on-disk: under <harness-root>/tools/. Confirm exact path shape against bl-7c23's final template layout before pinning text.
- No structural uses of 'exchange branch' or 'invocation' (TAXONOMY.md). Root conversation runs on main; subagents named by hyphenated descent.

=== Still open ===

- tool_result framing: is step N+1's request.json commit (§2.10) the commit that frames the tool_result blocks the agent reads for step N's tool calls, or do tool_calls have their own independent structural role? Salvage draft picked the former — confirm or propose alternative.
- Tool executor §3.2 description: ownership of subprocess lifecycle, atomic capture, SIGTERM cascade. Salvage draft's wording is good modulo the retargeted paths.

=== Deliverable ===

PR touching docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (§3.2, §3.3, §2.3 or its post-abfe713 equivalent, §12 v0.3, §11) and TAXONOMY.md / PRINCIPLES.md as needed for any new terms of art (flag any before introducing). No code. Coherent with abfe713's layout and bl-7c23's scope.

=== Coordination ===

Not blocked by bl-7c23 — this pins spec, bl-7c23 implements layout — but the final ARCH text must name final path strings; if bl-7c23 lands first and shifts a path, rebase the text against it.

=== Out of scope ===

- Handle-based async dispatch (v0.4).
- Oversized-output auto-dispatch (deferred).
- Subagent dispatch tool (v0.4).
title: v0.3 tool contract: pin ARCH §3.3 gaps
